title: Adding Non-Residential Rooms and Area
summary: See how to quickly and easily add non-residential rooms and areas to your building design for better layout optimization.
author: Zenerate

content.text: Non-residential spaces like lobbies, laundry rooms, bike parking, and facility rooms play a crucial role in enhancing a building’s functionality. They accommodate staff and provide essential amenities for tenants, making them an integral part of any well-designed project.
Zenerate makes it simple to incorporate these spaces into your preliminary design, ensuring a more realistic and optimized layout.
Within residential floors, you can easily convert existing units into non-residential spaces by following these steps:

text: 1. Click on a unit you would like to change.
2. Select the dropdown menu in the edit bar.
3. Choose the desired non-residential room type.

content.text: In parking areas, adding facility rooms is just as effortless:

text: 1. Click on your parking area layout.
3. Choose the type of non-residential space you want to add.
4. Drag and drop it onto the available space.

content.text: Zenerate will automatically adjust the parking layout and recalculate parking spot numbers to accommodate the new space.
